clarifications: Can there be duplicate numbers in the array? Yes, duplicates are allowed.
What should be returned if there are multiple solutions? The problem guarantees exactly one solution.
Can the input array be empty? No, the minimum length is 2.
Are negative numbers allowed? Yes, negative numbers are allowed.
Should the indices be returned in sorted order? No, any order is acceptable.
What if the same number can be used twice to reach the target? You cannot use the same element twice.
What if the array contains only two elements? The solution will involve these two elements.
expectedApproaches: Brute force with nested loops, O(n^2) time complexity.
Hash map for complement lookup, O(n) time complexity.
solutions: Use a hash map to store each number's index as you iterate through the array. For each number, calculate its complement (target - current number). If the complement is found in the hash map, return the indices of the current number and its complement.
commonMistakes: Using a nested loop leading to O(n^2) complexity.
Not checking if the complement is the same element.
Returning the value instead of indices.
